tldr: Lilith in Cancer: the wound fused with memory; old rejections replay and run the mood.
body: With Lilith in Cancer, the dark side merges with the emotional mind itself. Memories of abandonment, neglect, or feeling unloved stay live and get triggered by anything that echoes them, so past pain quietly steers present moods and choices.
gift: Deep emotional attunement and fierce protectiveness once the past is faced instead of replayed.
challenge: Rumination on old wounds, moods governed by memory, dark thinking that colors everything underneath.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
